g.ns1:text:
\begin{center}
\noindent 
``Teddy bears mixing \\
sparkling chemicals as \\
mad scientists, in \\
a steampunk style.''
\end{center}

\\begin{center}\n\\noindent ``Skill without imagination \\\\\nis craftsmanship and gives us \\\\\nmany useful objects such as \\\\\nwickerwork picnic baskets. \\\\\nImagination without skill \\\\\ngives us modern art.\'\'\\\\\n\\end{center}

\begin{center}
\noindent 
``I draw a jackal-headed\\
woman in the sand,\\
Sing of a lover's fate \\
sealed by jealous hate''
\end{center}

\begin{center}
\noindent ``L'habilet\'e sans l'imagination\\ 
est de l'artisanat et nous \\
donne de nombreux objets \\
utiles tels que des paniers \\
de pique-nique en osier. \\
L'imagination sans habilet\'e \\
nous donne l'art moderne.''
\end{center}
